claim_title: alpha-helix-selective SAE feature set exists (conditional, set-level; cross-organism)

figures.caption: A distributed set of ~19 Layer-26 SAE features detects alpha-helix codons, replicating across E. coli and H. sapiens (set AUROC 0.89 / 0.86) far above confound and shuffle-null baselines (~0.5).
